fnol_text: My name is Gabriel Vasquez and I live at 446 Ashford Court, Ashland, OR 97519. You can reach me on (555) 617-6434 or gabriel.vasquez@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 18 April 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00012. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Vasquez on (555) 617-6434 to acknowledge the claim. Gabriel confirmed the loss date as 18 April 2026.
Site visit to 446 Ashford Court. Neighbour Ingrid Wojcik was present and confirmed the timeline.
Gabriel sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
